timing: lethal assignment is checked before combat damage is dealt
targets: the attacked player, planeswalker, or battle after lethal blocker assignment
choices: the attacker controller divides full power among legal recipients
apnap: complete active-player assignment is validated atomically
layers: effective power, toughness, abilities, and marked damage are read at assignment
replacement_effects: prevention and damage-changing effects do not change the lethal-assignment threshold
control_change: only the current controller assigns damage
zone_change: a blocked trampler with no remaining blockers may assign to its attacked player or object when the rule permits
source_leaves: a departed source assigns no combat damage
